title: InvadedQueueShortener
description: Shortens and colors InvadedLands queue messages to keep your chat cleaner.
body:
# InvadedLands Queue Shortener

A client-side Fabric mod that shortens InvadedLands queue messages so your chat stays clean and easy to read.

InvadedLands queue messages normally include extra rank and leave-queue info every time your queue position updates. This mod trims that down to the useful part: which queue you are in and your current position.

Server IP: **invadedlands.net**

## Features

- Shortens long InvadedLands queue messages
- Supports multiple queues at the same time
- Splits broken combined queue messages into separate chat lines
- Custom queue message formats through the config
- Per-queue custom messages
- Minecraft color/style code support, like `&f`, `&7`, `&b`, `&l`, `&o`, etc.
- Placeholders:
  - `%server%` - queue/server name
  - `%pos%` - current queue position
  - `%max%` - max queue size
- Optional hover/click interaction support
- Can be enabled or disabled from the config
- Works with Mod Menu and YACL config screen

## Example Config
```
enabled=true
keepOriginalInteractions=false
default=&e%server% Queue Position: %pos%/%max%.
Event-B=&c&l%server% &fQueue Position: &b%pos%&7/&b%max%.
KitPVP=&b%server% Queue Position: &f%pos%&7/&f%max%.
```

## Hover Message

The original hover/click message can be kept if enabled in the config.  
You can also turn it off to avoid accidentally clicking the message and leaving the queue.
